model_selection_notes: max_depth chosen via sensitivity sweep over [3, 5, 8, 10, None]; R^2 plateaued at depth=8 (identical results through 'unlimited'), so 8 was chosen as the natural elbow rather than an arbitrary cap. Compared against a log-featured linear regression alternative (R^2=0.9633) -- tree retained for higher accuracy, though the log-linear result confirms the underlying rod-height response is genuinely log-shaped, which the tree approximates via flat segments rather than a smooth curve.
